page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head above and the page number at top right. The left edge carries stray marks and show-through from the neighbouring page, which are not transcribed. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: auris[?] tua ut non possit, nec cor durum ut nolit au-
dire, nec manus abbreviata, ut salvare nequeat
Me supplicem tuum desolatum.
Tu Me ab hominibus permisisti externis illis
mediis privari in Ecclesia tua à Te institutis,
haud vero me illa prohibent Internæ Gratiæ
communione, quam tu Cordibus humilium solus
inspiras.
O Me talem efficias, & jam (nullus dubi-
to) docebis Me, exaudies Me, adjuvabis Me.
Cor enim contritum & humiliatum Deus non de-
spicies.
Tu Me (Domine) una opera potes & Tem-
plum tibi & Sacerdotem, Victimamque &
Altare efficere, dum à Corde humili Solitarius inter
Sacras Meditationes, Preces fervidus, & non
ficitas lachrimas Me quotidie tibi fistam Oblatio-
nem, qui Me tibi preparas, in Me habitas, & à
Me dignaris accipere.
Tu secretis (Domine) reparationibus, & mira-
culosa infusione effecisti, ut pugillum farinæ
non deficeret Viduæ, nec Lecythus olei immi-
nucretur durante illa Fame & Siccitate.
O Animam meam intuearis, nunc quasi Vi-
duam quandam desertam & desolatam: Ne Sal-
vificæ istæ Veritates quas jam antea addidici è
memoria mea elabantur, nec illæ dulces Spiritu-
s Tui effusiones quas aliquando sensi, desituant
Cor Meum in hac fame ordinarii illius salubris
alimenti quo Anima mea reficeretur.
Quod tamen malim sustinere quam ab eorum
manu pabulari, qui panem meum miscent cine-

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. The printed "auris" at the start is hard to read (u shaped like n); marked [?]. "desituant" is unclear and may be a misprint for "desinant"; left as printed and marked [?]. "immi-nucretur" is printed this way (possibly a typo for "imminueretur"); left as printed. The catchword "cibus" is partly obscured; marked [?]. Greek running head copied as printed; some letters are small. Left-edge marks are show-through or the adjacent page, not transcribed.
